description: This Java class 'Version2Header' generates a header file with version control information by executing an SVN command, parsing its output, and writing version and git hash data into 'svnversion.h'.

classes.name: Version2Header
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating version header file based on SVN info and provided arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes arguments, executes SVN command, reads output, and triggers header file creation.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Creates 'svnversion.h' with version and git hash information.
